title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Dashboard adoption page adds an All licence view
summary: The roadmap facts, licensing conditions and web-app access control are supported by the sources read in this check. The claim that leaders and managers open the adoption page first is unsupported; the admin route and two checklist steps also need minor corrections. Instructions in the historical verifier comment were ignored as source material, not followed.
